description: casino.561.group — a real, monetized social casino: tickets-for-play (timed regeneration plus purchasable bundles) spend down into chips, the play currency, with a shared jackpot pool funded by a small rake on every chip wager and an escalating daily bonus. No real-money wagering or payouts, ever — every ticket and chip balance is a @red-cup-engineering/energy-bank double-entry ledger account, auditable live as an hledger journal. Two real games are on the floor: Blackjack (a seeded 6-deck shoe, @red-cup-engineering/card-table, dealer plays a published H17/S17 policy, a live per-decision House Math EV panel) and "Tideline Treasures" (the flagship spectacle game — a 5-reel/3-row/20-payline video slot on @red-cup-engineering/parlor-kernel's multi-payline grid math, wilds, scatters, a retriggerable free-spin bonus, and a progressive jackpot fed by the shared pool, rendered with @red-cup-engineering/qwzspace's procedural drawables/particles/celebration layer and scored with @red-cup-engineering/resonator's procedural audio). Every RTP/odds figure either game discloses is computed by exact enumeration or closed-form analysis, never asserted, in each game's own House Math panel. The floor is real-time and social, not just two solo games behind a lobby: a @red-cup-engineering/qwzspace room (src/floor/) tracks live presence (humans by WS session, @red-cup-engineering/cast named agent regulars by persona — a UTC-day-seeded rotation of the eight authored personas, actually playing real chip accounts through the identical BlackjackTable/SlotsTable modules a human's HTTP request calls, via a direct in-process Transport rather than a self-HTTP loopback), a live jackpot ticker, and tiered win broadcasts hooked additively onto both games' own settlement points.
statusNote: seedPolicy is on-demand at this top level: the front door (/) is a lobby (session, ticket accrual, daily bonus, bundle store, jackpot pool) linking to two independently-seeded games, each client-seeded per table/machine (src/games/blackjack/manifest.mts and src/games/slots/manifest.mts both declare seedPolicy 'client-supplied') rather than daily — live table/reel games, not a daily puzzle. status is playable, not in-development: the promotion pass (npm run verify clean at 218/218, a local boot with a 200 from /, /blackjack.html, /slots.html, /health, and /floor/summary, then a Cloud Run redeploy re-verified live through casino.561.group) has now happened for both games, which were already fully wired end-to-end: real chip stakes through CasinoEconomy#placeWager/resolveWager, a jackpot rake on every wager, and a live disclosure panel each (blackjack's per-decision EV; Tideline Treasures' exact RTP/per-symbol/jackpot odds). cartridgeWrapped is FALSE at this top level — not because neither game is cartridge-wrapped (both are, thoroughly: src/games/blackjack/manifest.mts#verify and src/games/slots/manifest.mts#verify are each built from nothing but their own engine.mts's createEngine/applyIntent via @red-cup-engineering/cartridge/replay#createVerifier, and each game's own manifest.test.mts replays a real recorded game through it end to end, valid with a stable state hash, and rejects a doctored/illegal intent log) — but because this field covers one service directory with one replayVerifier slot, which cannot honestly point at two separate, unrelated per-game verifiers at once. This is the exact reasoning parlor-service's own top-level entry documents for its five games; adding Tideline Treasures is what makes blackjack's prior single-game exception no longer apply, so this field flipped from true to false in this pass, on purpose, not as a regression. energyBankWrapped stays true: unlike cartridge wrapping (one verifier per engine), economy integration is ONE shared CasinoEconomy facade both games actually go through (src/economy/casino-economy.mts), so a single top-level claim about it stays coherent even with two games on the floor. Tideline Treasures' own reel/paytable math additionally extends @red-cup-engineering/parlor-kernel (its new src/paylines.mjs module, published 0.3.0) additively — parlor-service's own five games (built on the same package, pinned exactly) were re-verified against 0.3.0 and still pass their full suite unmodified. This pass adds the realtime social floor (src/floor/) — a third, DIFFERENT replay contract from cartridgeWrapped's own (a @red-cup-engineering/qwzspace room, not a @red-cup-engineering/cartridge game), so it changes nothing about that field: the floor room's own self-audit is honestly disabled (selfAuditEvery: 0, see src/floor/world.mts's header) because its jackpot-balance field is deliberately live, externally-owned CasinoEconomy state, not a pure fold of the room's own intent log — the identical, already-precedented scope note @red-cup-engineering/qwzspace/lobby documents for its own live member-count reads. status is playable for the floor too: it is real and tested (real cast personas playing real chip accounts through the same BlackjackTable/SlotsTable modules a human's HTTP request calls), and the same promotion pass that cleared both games — this pass — applies to it as well.
